title: The Lord's Faithfulness Endures Forever

questions.question: For great is his steadfast love toward whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 117:2 (ESV): "For great is his steadfast love toward us,"

questions.question: And the faithfulness of the Lord endures how long?
questions.explanation: Psalm 117:2 (ESV): "...and the faithfulness of the Lord endures forever."

questions.question: What is the final phrase of Psalm 117?
Psalm 117 is the shortest chapter in the Bible. How many verses does it have?
Who is called to praise the Lord in verse 1?
questions.explanation: Psalm 117:1 (ESV): "Praise the Lord, all nations! Extol him, all peoples!"

questions.question: What attribute of God is described as "great" toward us?
questions.explanation: Psalm 117:2 (ESV): "For great is his steadfast love toward us,"

questions.question: This Psalm is quoted by whom in the New Testament?
In the context of Romans 15, this Psalm supports the inclusion of whom?
questions.explanation: Paul uses it to show that Gentiles are called to praise God.

questions.question: "Hallelujah" means what?
questions.explanation: It is a transliteration of "Praise Yah" (Yahweh/Lord).

questions.question: Is Psalm 117 the middle chapter of the Bible?
questions.explanation: Depending on the version/canon, it is often cited as the middle chapter.

questions.question: What endures forever according to verse 2?
questions.explanation: Psalm 117:2 (ESV): "...and the faithfulness of the Lord endures forever."

questions.question: The term "peoples" in verse 1 refers to whom?

key_verse_text: Praise the Lord, all nations! Extol him, all peoples! For great is his steadfast love toward us, and the faithfulness of the Lord endures forever. Praise the Lord!
